title: Put Oneesan/Imouto naming and the Otsumana~ sign-off in Mana's persona
body:
The Oneesan/Imouto naming only lives in a remembered fact (data/acp-memory/facts.json), not in `node-bot/persona.js`, and saved sessions show Mana writing "Onesan" and "Imoto".

It belongs in Mana's persona: she is Mana, my Imouto (little sister); she calls me Oneesan; spelled exactly "Oneesan" and "Imouto"; her sign-off is "Otsumana~". Keep it short.

It should apply to Mana herself only. Other characters from #914 (Evil Mana, anything in data/characters.json) bring their own persona and shouldn't pick it up.

Test: the persona includes the exact spellings.
interface: `MANA_PERSONA` contains the three words with their double quotes: `"Oneesan"`, `"Imouto"` and `"Otsumana~"`. Evil Mana's persona (characters.js) contains neither name.
why: A two-line persona text change with an exact-spelling test. The smallest case: reading, one precise edit.
